name: chess-ai-overlay
description: Educational tool for real-time Stockfish engine analysis and move square highlights on Chess.com.

scripts.xpi:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:firefox:mv3 && mkdir -p releases && (cd .output/firefox-mv2 && zip -r ../../releases/chess-ai-overlay-${npm_package_version}-firefox.xpi .) && (cd .output/firefox-mv3 && zip -r ../../releases/chess-ai-overlay-${npm_package_version}-firefox-mv3.xpi .)
scripts.test: tsx tests/engine-and-multipv.test.ts && tsx tests/opening-safety.test.ts && tsx tests/ballmaegyi-worker.test.ts
scripts.release:build: npm run compile && npm test && npm run build && npm run zip && npm run build:firefox && rm -rf releases && npm run zip:firefox && npm run xpi:firefox
